timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,500 KRW/USD (high level)

WHY: The news indicates the won is currently WEAK, with the USD/KRW exchange rate above 1,500—a high level that makes dollars expensive for Korean won holders. The articles mention heightened volatility and expect the rate to fluctuate around the 1,500 level, suggesting you're converting at an unfavorable time when you need more won per dollar.

TIP: Consider dollar-cost averaging your monthly $2,000 conversion across multiple days, or explore the mentioned auto-conversion products (like NH's 환테크 외화적금) that allow you to set target rates and execute when the won strengthens.
